correction_text.description: 使用者提供的更正內容。

ref.description: 要處理的旁證編號 N（member_recall 結果中「〔旁證N〕」那行的數字）。只能指定你本人那次查詢（查詢對象是目前說話的人）結果裡的旁證；查別人的結果沒有可用編號。

query.description: The search query to find relevant memories.

top_k.description: Number of memories to retrieve (default 10, maximum 20).

content.description: The information to store in long-term memory.

content_origin.description: Optional. Where the stored content actually came from: 'user' (the user said it), 'agent' (your own statement or inference), 'tool' (a tool result), or 'unknown'. Omit if you are not sure; omitted is recorded as 'unknown', never assumed to be the user.

origin_evidence_ids.description: Optional. Evidence ids (ev_...) of the earlier statements this content comes from, if you know them.

reason.description: Why this information is important enough to remember.

salience.description: Importance score between 0.0 and 1.0 (default 0.85). Higher means more important.

member.description: 成員名稱（顯示名稱或暱稱）。
